description: tt marks a written T through the first original token of its span. During reparse, c reads synthetic T, then F through 🆓. The head of tt is F, so tt lacks Written and c fails. The reparse passes (engine §7.4, §7.5). Compare reparse-written-observation-text.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (A [+T] f)
%rule b (A [+T] [+T] f)
%rule c (A $t:tt) %conditions Written ⊆ $t.tags

%rule tt [+T 🆓] :: (T ⊆ $.first-token.tags ⟹ Written)
%rule 🆓 [{F}]
%rule f F
